verified_facts.text: The hotel offers ski-in, ski-out access to Beaver Creek Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy ski-in, ski-out access to over 2,000 acres at Beaver Creek Mountain.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's design draws on national park lodges, with timber beams and natural stone.
verified_facts.excerpt: this stunning Ritz-Carlton is an ode to “parkitecture,” with soaring timber beams and sturdy natural stone nodding to some of the iconic lodges of our National Parks

verified_facts.text: Rooms are styled as a modern mountain lodge, with stone fireplaces, wood accents and refreshed furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: a sophisticated translation of a modern mountain lodge, incorporating stone fireplaces, wood accents and refreshed furnishings

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers three- and four-bedroom penthouses for large gatherings of family and friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: 3-and 4-bedroom penthouses for large gatherings with family and friends.

verified_facts.text: Sakaba is a contemporary sushi restaurant at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sakaba meaning "bar" in Japanese is a contemporary sushi restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Anderson's Cabin, above the hotel, is the original home of John Anderson, one of seven bachelors who settled the area in the 1900s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anderson's Cabin is the original home of John Anderson, one of seven bachelors who settled the area in the 1900s.

verified_facts.text: Anderson's Cabin offers private dining for up to 10 guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anderson's Cabin offers an exclusive private dining experience for up to 10 guests.

verified_facts.text: The spa's signature Miner's Mineral Mud Wrap uses activated charcoal sourced from Colorado mines.
verified_facts.excerpt: activated charcoal sourced from Colorado mines is used in the spa’s signature Miner’s Mineral Mud Wrap

verified_facts.text: The spa has a grotto, a Himalayan salt wall dry sauna, a steam room and a cold plunge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Amenities including The Grotto, Himalayan Salt Wall Dry Sauna, Steam Room, and Cold Plunge

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a Ritz Kids program for children ages 5 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Ritz Kids program gives children ages 5 – 12 the ultimate vacation experience

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a Ski Nanny Program for children's ski lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Ski Nanny Program provides a seamless experience for your children’s ski lessons

verified_facts.text: Complimentary transportation to Beaver Creek Village is available through the Village Connect app.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary transportation from our hotel in Beaver Creek to Beaver Creek Village is available through the Village Connect app.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with up to two pets per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The Ritz-Carlton, Bachelor Gulch. Up to 2 pets are allowed per room.

verified_facts.text: On property, guests are fairly isolated from everything else.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’re pretty isolated from everything else

verified_facts.text: Spa services and facilities are for guests 18 or older.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Bachelor Gulch Spa services and facilities are for guests 18 years of age or older.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge is closed from Sept. 7 to Nov. 19 and reopens Nov. 20.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Club Lounge is closed Sept. 7 – Nov. 19; re-opening Nov. 20.
